const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""KinDER i00 real-robot-style cube sorting driver.
+
+This file is kept alongside the run as the record of the control procedure.
+The episode is driven in small, observation-guided chunks from this script.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROBOT: Robot | None = None
+
+
+def connect() -> Robot:
+    global ROBOT
+    if ROBOT is None:
+        ROBOT = Robot()
+    return ROBOT
+
+
+def observe(cameras=None, depth=False):
+    return connect().get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="frames")
+
+
+def move(rows, cameras=None, note=""):
+    """Execute rows of 11 delta controls (base x/y/yaw, 7 joints, gripper)."""
+    return connect().submit("delta", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32),
+                            cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note)
+
+
+def status():
+    return connect().status()
+
+
+def main():
+    r = connect()
+    print(json.dumps({"spec": r.spec(), "status": r.status()}, indent=2))
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="frames", include_depth=True)
+    for name, frame in obs.last.items():
+        try:
+            from PIL import Image
+            Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"initial_{name}.jpg")
+        except ImportError:
+            pass
+    print(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
p=np.array([[.1199,0,.5512],[.1199,-.0054,.6796],[.1199,-.0117,.89],[.1199,-.0181,1.1004],[.1199,-.0245,1.3088],[.1199,-.0247,1.4147],[.1199,-.0249,1.5207],[.1199,-.0249,1.7261]])

q=np.array([0,-.349,3.14159,-2.548,0,-.873,1.5708])
R=np.eye(3); t=np.zeros(3)
# transform coordinate basis from base; each home displacement expressed base-frame aligned with initial home? translation is applied then rotation in current parent local axis, axis vectors are base-frame at home but rotate with preceding links.
t=p[0].copy()
for i in range(7):
    # rotating link subsequent offsets around axis at current joint
    Ri=Rotation.from_rotvec(a[i]*q[i]).as_matrix()
    # t currently position of joint i in transformed coordinates; apply rotation orientation
    # accumulate orientation and then translate to next joint using transformed home displacement
    R=R@Ri
    t=t+R@(p[i+1]-p[i])
    print(i+1,t)

+    [0.1199, -0.0249, 1.5207], [0.1199, -0.0249, 1.7261],
+], dtype=float)
+JOINT_AXES = np.array([
+    [0, 0, -1], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, -1], [0, 1, 0],
+    [0, 0, -1], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, -1],
+], dtype=float)
+
+
+def fk(q):
+    """Forward kinematics from the documented zero pose and joint axes."""
+    R = np.eye(3)
+    p = HOME_JOINTS[0].copy()
+    for i in range(7):
+        R = R @ Rotation.from_rotvec(JOINT_AXES[i] * float(q[i])).as_matrix()
+        p = p + R @ (HOME_JOINTS[i + 1] - HOME_JOINTS[i])
+    return p, R
+
+
+def solve_ik(target_xyz, seed, tool_z=(0, 0, -1), axis_weight=0.6,
+             seed_weight=0.002, max_nfev=1800):
+    """Solve position plus approach-axis IK while staying near a seed pose."""
+    seed = np.asarray(seed, dtype=float)
+    target_xyz = np.asarray(target_xyz, dtype=float)
+    tool_z = np.asarray(tool_z, dtype=float)
+    lo, hi = seed - 4 * np.pi, seed + 4 * np.pi
+    lo[1], hi[1] = -2.24, 2.24
+    lo[3], hi[3] = -2.57, 2.57
+    lo[5], hi[5] = -2.09, 2.09
+
+    def residual(q):
+        pos, R = fk(q)
+        return np.r_[(pos - target_xyz) * 3.0,
+                     (R[:, 2] - tool_z) * axis_weight,
+                     (q - seed) * seed_weight]
+
+    sol = least_squares(residual, seed, bounds=(lo, hi), max_nfev=max_nfev,
+                        ftol=1e-9, xtol=1e-9, gtol=1e-9)
+    pos, R = fk(sol.x)
+    return sol.x, pos, R
+
+
+def red_components(frame):
+    """Find likely dark-red cube blobs in a base-camera RGB frame."""
+    from scipy import ndimage
+    im = np.asarray(frame)
+    mask = ((im[:, :, 0] > 65) & (im[:, :, 0] > 1.65 * im[:, :, 1]) &
+            (im[:, :, 0] > 1.55 * im[:, :, 2]) &
+            (im[:, :, 1] < 95) & (im[:, :, 2] < 90))
+    labels, n = ndimage.label(mask)
+    out = []
+    for k in range(1, n + 1):
+        ys, xs = np.where(labels == k)
+        if len(xs) >= 18:
+            out.append({"pixels": int(len(xs)), "xmin": int(xs.min()),
+                        "ymin": int(ys.min()), "xmax": int(xs.max()),
+                        "ymax": int(ys.max()),
+                        "center_u": float(xs.mean()),
+                        "bottom_v": float(ys.max())})
+    return sorted(out, key=lambda b: (b["bottom_v"], b["pixels"]), reverse=True)
+
+
+def base_pixel_to_base(u, v, fovy_deg=52.2, width=640, height=480):
+    """Project a base-camera pixel onto z=0 in the base frame."""
+    fy = height / (2 * np.tan(np.deg2rad(fovy_deg) / 2))
+    fx = fy  # square pixels and 4:3 RGB
+    ray = (np.array([1/np.sqrt(2), 0, -1/np.sqrt(2)]) +
+           ((u - width/2) / fx) * np.array([0, -1, 0]) +

+    cam = np.array([0.2525, 0, 0.335])
+    return cam + t * ray
